title: gibasis venustula subsp. peninsulae
intro: Gibasis venustula subsp. peninsulae, commonly known as Peninsula False Foxglove, is a perennial plant species native to the Philippines. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-hypertensive, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties. The Peninsula False Foxglove is used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and wounds, due to its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
